##### SECTION M7 (-F on an incremental whose receiver is ahead (U1/U2), rollback -r vs local user properties (U4), modified head (U5), full stream onto a copy with snapshots (U6))  tag=C  zfs-2.3.9-0+deb13u1
#note: U1: sender zfsbcapc/M7/u1src has old,new1,new2. Each receiver t_* is built with a full stream of @old and an incremental to @new1 (its history is AHEAD of the base @old). Then: zfs send -i @old @new2 | zfs receive [-F] -s -u
